# Changelog title: Proxied providers send platform connections through their proxy and mark them for platform accounting
Removed the unused FP2 client window
The proxy heatmap popup shows lifetime billable and total traffic in each direction
Proxy UDP relay coverage
`urnet-tools status` redesign
Choose the extender's UDP 443, UDP 4053 and UDP 53 carriers independently with `urnet-tools set extender-udp443|extender-udp4053|extender-udp53 on|off`
Extender status reports the UDP port 53 state and bind failure reason
Gossip diagnostics include dial counters, health transitions, recent events and rate-limited anomaly dumps
The proxy heatmap shows addresses on hover or click, separates the direct connection and explains the grid in help
Extender setup offers the UDP port 53 sysctl threshold as an explicit opt-in
The Linux interface counter reader exposes cumulative receive and transmit bytes
The container image includes the Go top dashboard
Extender discovery now defaults to on when the extender role runs
`urnet-tools top` can show decimal units
Traffic the extender relays, per carrier
`urnet-tools top` adds interactive diagnostics
Selectable heatmap styles
In `urnet-tools top`, `g` opens the goroutine list as an overlay when the window has no room for the Internals panel
`urnet-tools top` redraws at most 20 times a second
The graph axes follow the columns on screen
The heatmap gives each proxy state its own color: dropped is orange, connecting is violet and dead is bold red, and the throughput shades stay in green to aqua
`urnet-tools top` advances live traffic graphs on each fast refresh and labels the visible duration
Backend failure counts and timestamps are published together as one snapshot
A pinned IP family with no route sleeps instead of redialing
The `[t]auth error` and `[contract]oob err` lines name the failed mode, the pinned family and the causes an exhausted request retained, such as `no route to host`
Proxy add accepts passwords containing an `@` sign
The CFAA sync commits generated tables directly to the main branch after its format checks
Status update checks do not follow symbolic links in the cache
Failed carrier control writes restore the previous carrier configuration
Lossless prefix-bucket host blocker format and Telegram reflector test alignment
Proxy credentials stay out of logs, status and control replies
